lines.text: Some Greeks at the feast asked Philip from Bethsaida to see Jesus, and Philip told Andrew.
Jesus said the hour had come for the Son of Man to be glorified, and a kernel of wheat must die to bear fruit.
Jesus said anyone who serves Him must follow Him and the Father will honor him, and that His soul was glad.
After Jesus asked the Father to glorify His name, a voice came from heaven, and some in the crowd said a prophet had spoken.
Jesus told the crowd to believe in the Light so they would become sons of light, and then He went away and was hidden from them.
